'''Kuamasi''' (''{{IPA|kʰua33 ma33 sɨ55}}''; {{lang-zh|跨玛斯话}}; Songping Yi 松坪彝) is a [[Loloish language]] of [[Heqing County]], [[Yunnan]], China. They are known by the [[Kua-nsi language|Kua-nsi]] as ''{{IPA|kʰua33 ma33 sɨ55}}''. The Kuamasi are found in Matang 麻塘,<ref>http://www.ynszxc.gov.cn/villagePage/vIndex.aspx?departmentid=132341 {{Dead link|date=March 2022}}</ref> Songping Village 松坪村, Liuhe Township 六合乡, [[Heqing County]] (Castro, et al. 2010).<ref>Andy Castro, Brian Crook, Royce Flaming. 2010. ''[http://www.sil.org/silesr/2010/silesr2010-001_English.pdf A sociolinguistic survey of Kua-nsi and related Yi varieties in Heqing county, Yunnan province, China]''. SIL International.</ref> A Loloish language spoken in Daying Village 大营村,<ref>http://www.ynszxc.gov.cn/villagePage/vIndex.aspx?departmentid=114838 {{Dead link|date=March 2022}}</ref> Songgui Town 松桂镇 is also likely closely related to Kuamasi (Castro 2010:23).
